definitions: Any of several plants of the genus Polygonum, with jointed stems and inconspicuous flowers

blocks.text: Knotweed is a common name for plants in several genera in the family Polygonaceae. Knotweed may refer to:

items:
Reynoutria
Reynoutria japonica or Japanese knotweed, a highly invasive species in Europe and North America
